body:
I'm fifteen years old and I found that Calea Zacatechichi could help me lucid dream and aid in dream recall. So I found a great dealer of Calea Zacatechichi online and ordered 200 grammes, I recieved the dried leaves about 3 days ago.
Obviously, I studied the plant on the internet as best I could, and in doing so I came across a post by davion about his experience, using 2 500ml capsules. So I ground up the dried plant matter in to the finest dust I could and got it into the gel capsules as best I could. The first night I took two 500mg capsules, and immediatly went to sleep. I began to start in a very detailed dream but my mom came in and woke me up for some reason or other. But what was interesting about that part is that I remember the fact that the dream hadn't been going long, like the start of a movie, I remember I was talking to a man with red hair when she woke me up.
The next night (last night) I tried 3 500ml capsules, and though the dream wasn't completely lucid it did have shocking reality and I was semi-lucid. In this dream I got to see an old friend again, one I've not seen in years. It was so detailed so clear and now several hours later I still remember it. My friend and I talked, he didn't remember me at first then we reminissed and he remembered me. We were at our old elementary school, then this girl came who, in real live, supposedly could never keep her fingers out of her bodily orfices, she made my friend run away, as in real live she would always chase people with her hands held out trying to touch people.
To make a long story short I believe that the calea helped me have this dream, in which I got to speak to my best friend from years past once more. Best stuff, I've ever tried. I'm gonna go drink so tea now, geuss what kind. LOL!
